features: Preferred Spotify iPhone/device stored locally with device_id, name and type fallback
Controlled transfer, playlist launch, shuffle activation and playback verification
Optional automatic opening of Driving mode from an iOS shortcut
Driving mode queue panel with current track and up to 20 upcoming tracks
Updated iOS Shortcuts setup: open Spotify, wait, then open the Shuffle+ URL
Random playlist offset by default when shuffle is enabled and force-first is disabled
known_limits: A live Spotify Premium account and the user iPhone are required for end-to-end validation
Spotify may omit devices from the available devices response and a saved device_id may change
The Spotify iOS app should be opened immediately before the Shuffle+ shortcut URL
